sloka: गम्यतामनुजानामि रामस्यानुचरी भव ।कथयन्त्या हि मधुरं त्वयाहं परितोषिता ॥ २.११९.९॥
transliteration: gamyatāmanujānāmi rāmasyānucarī bhava ।kathayantyā hi madhuraṁ tvayāhaṁ paritoṣitā ॥ 2.119.9॥

translations.english: O Sita, adorned with stars, the night has commenced. You can see the moon rising in the sky spreading his mantle of light.
